scope_notes: Actor sheets and reachable creation, advancement, requisition, disposition, subtlety, fear and Fate dialogs. Fate/sanity runtime files were read only for reachable sheet dialogs; their unrelated chat/runtime strings are outside this payload.
Item/UI namespace overlap is intentional; root merges with item-ui translations.
No original source file was edited. No Actor/Item document names, descriptions, catalogue records, IDs, stored values, formulas or references were altered.
Rule-page references remain the source English page numbers; no guessed Russian repagination.
QualityRules.* descriptions are deliberately absent (0 translated keys).

Action labels matching named talents/traits (Frenzy, Whirlwind of Death, Hip Shooting, Assassin Strike, Thunder Charge, Killing Strike, Eye of Vengeance, Never Die, Weapon-Tech, Mind Lock) remain English as catalog identifiers, while standard action/attack options are localized.

hardcoded_strings.warning: These options have no value attributes. Preserve submitted English enum values explicitly when localizing visible text; replacing text alone changes severity and triggers the Minor fallback.
Used as display abbreviations by apex-actor-context.mjs. Localize display only; never change characteristic keys.
DH2E_SPECIALIST_GROUPS labels bypass native i18n. Localize the group labels; specialization identifiers and stored keys remain unchanged.
Human-readable status grades bypass native i18n. Preserve names of actual disorder/malignancy/mutation entries.

characteristic_advance_levels.explanation: Apex.Tiers.1..5 and Advancement.Levels.* are the five characteristic advance levels, not the three talent tiers. apex-actor-context.mjs reads characteristicAdvances for Apex.Tiers; dh2e-advancement.mjs reads DH2E_CHARACTERISTIC_ADVANCE_LEVELS. Keep book progression.characteristic_rank_ru terminology.
